description: Given one 13D/A or 13G/A amendment (issuer + accession_number), find the SAME reporting group's prior filing in the chain and diff what changed: percent of class, aggregate shares owned, sole/shared voting & dispositive power (per reporting owner, matched by CIK or name), and — for 13D — whether the Item 4 purpose text changed. Walks back through the issuer's filing history (bounded, never a bulk crawl) matching on reporting-owner identity, since EDGAR does not carry an explicit "previous accession" link for this form family. Reports `prior_filing_found: false` honestly if no matching prior filing turns up within the scan bound, or if the chain predates the structured-XML rule (diffing free text is not meaningful).

accession_number.description: Accession number of the AMENDMENT (13D/A or 13G/A) to diff against its predecessor. Also accepts an original 13D/13G, in which case there is by definition no prior filing.

ticker_or_cik.description: Ticker, company name, or CIK of the ISSUER.

name: sec_13d_amendment_diff
title: Sec 13d Amendment Diff
